note: Orc warrior, side view, facing right (image right). Hood/hair, ear, face and the full dark beard are head; beard bottom y~424 at the right, rising to hair bottom y~380-404 at the left where the neck strip shows below it. Neck skin, leather collar, chest harness (rivets at x~505 and x~605), belt (y~630-675), the tassets/pouches hanging to y~780 and the indigo cape behind (x232-400, y500-832) are torso. The armoured skirt hem is the hip (y~780); the thighs are hidden, so the lower legs (dark boot shafts) start at the hem and no thigh is labelled. Ankles at the instep (left y~872, right y~852); the feet point right. Which arm is near or far is not clear from the art. Left arm (image left, swung back): big leather pauldron plus the bare skin wedge under it are upper arm (shoulder y~425, elbow y~595 where the dark leather bracer begins), the bracer is forearm, wrist y~674 where the bare fist begins; the fist (to y~752) is hand. Right arm (image right) holds a war hammer: only a narrow strip of upper arm shows along the chest edge (x~630-665, shoulder y~455, elbow y~577 where the dark bracer begins), the bracer is forearm (x627-682), wrist y~642 where the bare fist begins; fist (x645-715, y642-735) is hand. The hammer head and the handle above the fist are equipment, kept off the fist. Dark art: seams were read on brightened crops.
